name: show-image
description: Show PNGs inline in the conversation (dofile graphs and other tools' images, /img, show_image) with an optional zoom/pan pane. Inline images need Ghostty, kitty, or iTerm2 3.5+ in fullscreen; other terminals get alt text and an open-in-viewer button.

openPane.title: Open the image pane
openPane.description: Open the zoom and pan pane whenever an image is shown. Off: the picture shows inline in the conversation only (add --pane to /img to open the pane once).
